0022600202.text: Miami (3-6) sits ninth in the East and third in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, after a loss in its last game, and it has gone 2-3 on the road. Sacramento (1-8) is 15th in the West, has dropped two straight, and is 0-4 at home, with Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) all out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with Miami winning the last meeting 130-117 in Sacramento on January 20, 2026.
